references.text: The prophecy of the suffering of the Messiah, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of the events described in Mark 15:22.
Psalm 22 describes a suffering that resembles what Jesus experienced, including being led to the place of his execution.
Matthew's parallel account of Jesus being led to Golgotha.
Luke's parallel account of Jesus being led to the place called The Skull.
John's account of Jesus carrying his cross out to the place called The Place of a Skull.
